title: Dan Sherman taken to an NSA complex for sine-wave training

tellings.quote: he got taken to this NSA complex and he was given these headphones

plain: In the 1990s, a man named Dan Sherman was taken to a complex of the NSA, the US eavesdropping agency, in Maryland, perhaps at Fort Meade, where "he was given these headphones" and trained with sine-wave tones. Michels tells this from what Sherman has said, and credits Sherman's book Above Black. If true, a US intelligence agency was quietly training people in some unusual secret skill.
